sonnet.problem: This card asks whether Pharaoh listens to the magicians (Exodus 8:19). That line repeats Exodus 8:15, 'he hardened his heart and would not listen... just as the LORD had said', which stop 2 card 5 already asked about. The repeated line gets asked a second time.
sonnet.rule: When a line repeats in the passage, like a psalm's refrain, ask about it only the first time it appears in this passage.
